description: This file provides polyfill implementations or wrappers around the standard Python traceback module functions, specifically extract_tb and clear_frames, with additional decorator support for graph substitution.

methods.name: StackSummary extract_tb(tb: TracebackType | None, limit: int | None = None)
methods.description: A wrapper around traceback.extract_tb that supports substitution in graph, limiting the number of frames returned.

methods.name: None clear_frames(tb: TracebackType | None)
methods.description: A no-op wrapper around traceback.clear_frames, supporting substitution in graph.
